errors.text_span: Eine weitere farbige Linie stellt die Jahre 2020, 2021, 2022 und 2023 dar.
errors.evidence: The figure has separate lines for 2020 (mauve), 2021 (purple), 2022 (green), and 2023 (light blue), not one single line representing all four years.

errors.text_span: Der Startpunkt der Linie für 2025 liegt bei etwa 35 Prozent im Januar und steigt kontinuierlich auf etwa 95 Prozent im Juli
errors.evidence: The light-blue 2025 line starts near 78% in January, drops to around 15-20% in April, then rises; it does not start at 35% nor rise continuously to 95% by July.

errors.text_span: um dann auf etwa 90 Prozent im Dezember zu fallen.
errors.evidence: The 2025 line ends closer to about 90% in December, but the 2024 dark-blue line ends nearer about 78-80%, so the stated ending value is inaccurate for the described 2025 series only because of the earlier misidentification; this span is still misleading in context.

errors.text_span: Der Startpunkt der Linie für 2024 liegt bei etwa 30 Prozent im Januar
errors.evidence: The dark-blue 2024 line begins around 90% in January, not 30%.

errors.text_span: und steigt kontinuierlich auf etwa 95 Prozent im August, um dann auf etwa 90 Prozent im Dezember zu fallen.
errors.evidence: The 2024 line does not rise from 30% to 95%; it falls early in the year, then climbs to around 96-97% around late summer/early autumn and ends around 79-80% in December.

The description mentions the axes generally but omits the x-axis tick interval/labels as shown (monthly ticks with German date labels such as '1. Jan', '1. Feb', etc.) and does not state the x-axis scale type explicitly.
The y-axis is described as 0 to 100 percent, but the description omits the y-axis tick interval (10-unit increments) and does not mention the axis label shown as '%'.
The description omits the marker shape used for the 'Speicherverpflichtung' series and does not describe the individual yearly line colors for 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 separately.
